# BrandFit by Pixel Pro Lab

BrandFit by Pixel Pro Lab is an open-source utility created by Pixel Pro Lab, and it is a privacy-first web application for preparing logo grids and brand asset collections.

Live app: https://brandfit-design.netlify.app/
GitHub repository: https://github.com/PixelProLab/BrandFit
Maintainer: Pixel Pro Lab

## What BrandFit does

BrandFit by Pixel Pro Lab is an automated batch image resizer, aspect ratio fitting tool, padding utility, and brand assets optimizer. It helps users upload multiple logos, icons, or graphics, trim transparent whitespace, optically balance visual weight, normalize color, manually adjust individual logo scale, and export standardized PNG, WebP, or SVG-wrapper files in a ZIP.

## Privacy model

BrandFit by Pixel Pro Lab processes files locally in the browser. Image processing uses browser Canvas APIs, Blob URLs, and client-side ZIP generation. Uploaded files are not sent to a server.
